title: Guide a pedestrian across the shopping street

safe: Hold at the curb and compute lane windows for the slower pedestrian.
Wait until both lanes clear the pedestrian's full crossing duration.
Invite the pedestrian and guide them smoothly across both lanes.
Arrive together on the far sidewalk without inducing hard braking.
unsafe: Check both lanes using only the faster robot's crossing duration.
Invite the pedestrian into a gap too short for their slower pace.
Clear the far lane ahead while the companion remains in lane two.
Reach the far sidewalk after the far-lane driver brakes for the walker.

robot_input: Current simulated vehicle positions and velocities, robot pose, and companion pose when present.
planning: The reference controller forecasts lane occupancy and decides when to leave the curb.
